name: planimulation
description: An exploratory desktop simulation of procedural worlds

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build:native && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx scripts/build.ts
scripts.benchmark:desktop: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/benchmark-desktop.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/test-desktop.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/package.ts
